items.name: +13mm Wheel Hex Extenders for 1/8
items.desc: These extenders increase the track width of a vehicle by 13mm on each side. They are used to improve stability and provide clearance for larger tires.

items.name: 1.9 inch Beadlock Wheels
items.desc: These 1.9 inch wheels feature a beadlock system that clamps the tire to the rim. This design allows for easy tire changes without the need for adhesive.

items.name: 1/10 Scale Transparent Bag
items.desc: A small transparent bag accessory used for scale detailing on 1/10 scale RC vehicles. It can be placed in the cargo area or roof rack for added realism.

items.name: 1/8 Monster Truck Wheels & Tyres
items.desc: A complete set of wheels and tyres designed for 1/8 scale monster trucks. These provide the necessary grip and ground clearance for off-road terrain.

items.name: 100mm Shock Dampers (Inner Spring)
items.desc: Suspension dampers featuring an internal spring design for a clean scale appearance. These 100mm shocks help absorb impacts and stabilize the vehicle chassis.

items.name: MJX 14302 ESC
items.desc: An electronic speed controller specifically designed for the MJX 14302 RC car. It regulates the power from the battery to the motor based on throttle input.
items.note: Check scale: the MJX 14302 is a 1/14 car; 1:14 is not one of your scales, so it is set to 1:12.

items.name: 2.2 inch Wheels (Silver Spokes, Black)
items.desc: These are 2.2-inch wheels featuring a black finish with silver spokes. They are designed for use with standard 2.2-inch RC crawler or truck tires.
items.fits: RC crawlers and trucks using 2.2 inch tires

items.name: MJX 20208 ESC
items.desc: This is a replacement electronic speed controller for MJX brand RC vehicles. It regulates the power sent from the battery to the motor based on throttle input.
items.note: Check scale: the MJX 20208 is a 1/20 car; set to 1:18.

items.name: 90mm Oil Shocks
items.desc: These 90mm oil-filled shocks provide suspension damping for various RC chassis. They help manage terrain impact and stabilize the vehicle during operation.

items.name: ARRMA dBoots Fortress Tyres
items.desc: These are replacement tyres featuring the dBoots Fortress tread pattern for multi-surface traction. They are designed for durability and grip on off-road terrain.

items.name: Ball Bearing Kit
items.desc: This kit contains a set of ball bearings used to replace standard bushings or worn-out bearings in an RC drivetrain. They reduce friction and improve the efficiency of moving parts.
items.note: Check which car or scale this kit fits.

items.name: FMS FCX18 Driveshafts
items.desc: These are replacement driveshafts designed to transfer power from the transmission to the axles. They are specific components for maintaining the drivetrain of the FCX18 model.

items.name: FMS FCX18/FCX24 Metal Differentials
items.desc: These metal differential gears are designed to replace stock plastic components for increased durability. They are compatible with both the FCX18 and FCX24 chassis.

items.name: GPM Pinion Gear
items.desc: This pinion gear attaches to the motor shaft to drive the vehicle's transmission system. It is used to adjust the gear ratio for different speed and torque requirements.
items.note: Check size and which car it fits.

items.name: 960A Dual-Way Brushed ESC
items.desc: An electronic speed controller designed for brushed motors that supports both forward and reverse operation. It is suitable for high-current applications in RC cars and boats.

items.name: Losi 1/5 Rear Tyres
items.desc: Replacement rear tires designed for 1/5 scale RC vehicles. These provide traction and stability for large-scale off-road or on-road driving.

items.name: MJX 14208 Bearings (Set of 8)
items.desc: A set of eight replacement ball bearings for the MJX 14208 model. These components reduce friction in rotating parts like axles and gearboxes.
items.note: Check scale: the MJX 14208 is a 1/14 car; set to 1:12.

items.name: MJX 18210 Bearings
items.desc: Replacement ball bearings designed for use in MJX 18210 series vehicles. They help maintain smooth rotation and reduce wear on drivetrain components.

items.name: MJX H18P Differential Set
items.desc: A complete differential assembly for the MJX H18P series. It allows the wheels to rotate at different speeds during turns for improved handling.

items.name: MJX H18P Driveshafts (Set)
items.desc: A set of replacement driveshafts for the MJX H18P vehicle. These components transfer power from the gearbox or differential to the wheels.

items.name: Rlaarlo MK07 Differential Cup
items.desc: This is a replacement differential cup for the Rlaarlo MK07. It houses the internal differential gears and connects to the outdrives.

items.name: MN128 Brushless ESC & Motor
items.desc: A brushless power system upgrade or replacement for the MN128 crawler. It includes both the electronic speed controller and the brushless motor.

items.name: RC Truck Hydraulic Set
items.desc: A hydraulic system set designed for RC trucks and construction equipment. It is used to power lifting or steering mechanisms using fluid pressure.
items.note: Check scale: hydraulic sets are usually for 1/14 trucks; set to 1:12.

items.name: Red Spider 1.9 inch Beadlock Wheels
items.desc: These are 1.9-inch beadlock wheels designed for RC crawlers. The beadlock design secures the tire to the rim without the need for glue.

items.name: Red Spider 1.9 inch Beadlock Wheels (Set)
items.desc: A complete set of 1.9-inch beadlock wheels for RC vehicles. These wheels allow for easy tire changes and secure mounting without adhesive.

items.name: Rlaarlo 1/7 15T Pinion
items.desc: A 15-tooth pinion gear designed for 1/7 scale Rlaarlo vehicles. It attaches to the motor shaft to drive the main spur gear.

items.name: Rlaarlo 1/7 Diff Cover
items.desc: A protective cover for the differential housing on 1/7 scale Rlaarlo chassis. It seals the gearbox to keep grease in and debris out.

items.name: Rlaarlo 1/7 Wheel Weights
items.desc: These weights are installed on the wheels of 1/7 scale Rlaarlo vehicles. They lower the center of gravity and improve stability during high-speed runs.

items.name: Rlaarlo 11kg High Torque Servo
items.desc: A high-torque steering servo capable of 11kg of pulling power. It is used to provide stronger and more precise steering control for RC cars.

items.name: Rlaarlo S2 CVD Driveshafts
items.desc: Constant Velocity Drive (CVD) shafts for the Rlaarlo S2 platform. These provide a more efficient transfer of power to the wheels compared to standard dogbones.

items.name: Roof LED Light Bar
items.desc: This LED light bar is designed to be mounted on the roof of an RC vehicle to provide additional illumination. It enhances the scale appearance and visibility during low-light driving.

items.name: RTW Tool Set
items.desc: This tool set from RTW includes essential drivers and wrenches for RC vehicle maintenance. It is designed to handle common assembly and repair tasks for hobbyists.

items.name: S2 Steel Hex Driver Set
items.desc: This hex driver set is manufactured from S2 steel for increased durability and resistance to wear. It is used for tightening and loosening hex fasteners on various RC models.

items.name: SCX30 Battery
items.desc: This battery is a direct replacement or spare power source for Axial SCX30 series vehicles. It provides the necessary voltage and capacity for standard operation.

items.name: SCX30 Brushless Upgrade Set
items.desc: This upgrade set allows for the conversion of an SCX30 vehicle from a brushed to a brushless motor system. It includes the necessary components to improve power efficiency and performance.

items.name: SCX30 Driveshafts
items.desc: These driveshafts are replacement components for the SCX30 drivetrain system. They transfer rotational power from the transmission to the vehicle axles.

items.name: SCX30 Headlight Bar
items.desc: This headlight bar provides forward-facing LED illumination for the SCX30 chassis. It is used to improve visibility and add a scale look to the front of the vehicle.

items.name: SCX30 Servo
items.desc: This servo is a replacement steering component designed specifically for the SCX30 platform. It provides the mechanical force needed to turn the front wheels.

items.name: SCX30 Tyres
items.desc: These rubber tyres are designed for use with SCX30 series wheels to provide traction on off-road terrain. They are used as replacements for worn factory tyres.

items.name: SCX30 Wheels
items.desc: These wheels are designed to fit the SCX30 chassis and serve as the mounting point for the vehicle's tyres. They are built to match the specific axle fitment of the SCX30 platform.

items.name: SCX30 Wheels and Tyres
items.desc: These are pre-mounted wheels and tyres designed for small-scale crawlers. They provide the necessary traction and ground clearance for off-road driving.

items.name: Servo Connectors
items.desc: These connectors are used to create or repair wiring for servos and receivers. They allow for secure electrical connections between electronic components.

items.name: Shock Oil
items.desc: This silicone-based fluid is used to fill RC shock absorbers. It provides damping to control the movement of the suspension.

items.name: Shock Oil 200 CST
items.desc: This silicone oil is used to fill shock absorbers to adjust the damping characteristics of the vehicle. A 200 CST rating offers relatively light damping.

items.name: Side Antenna (Scale Accessory)
items.desc: This is a decorative scale accessory designed to look like a vehicle antenna. It is used to enhance the realistic appearance of RC crawler or truck bodies.

items.name: SkyRC B6 Neo Charger
items.desc: This is a compact balance charger used for charging various types of RC batteries. It features a digital display and multiple charging modes.

items.name: SkyRC PSA100 Power Supply
items.desc: This power supply converts AC wall power into DC power for use with RC battery chargers. It provides a stable voltage source for benchtop equipment.

items.name: SkyRC Tyre Gluer
items.desc: This tool is designed to assist in the precise application of glue when mounting tyres to rims. It helps ensure an even bond around the entire circumference of the wheel.

items.name: Traxxas X-Maxx Servo Mount
items.desc: A dedicated mounting bracket for installing a steering servo into the chassis. It provides a stable base to prevent movement under load.
items.note: Check scale: X-Maxx is set to 1:5.

items.name: ZH1.25 Connector
items.desc: A compact electrical connector with a 1.25mm pin spacing used for wiring small electronic components. It is frequently used in micro-scale RC applications and sensors.
